text: dsh-brief（DSH 插件，适用于任意 Agent 客户端）：按需收集 Hacker News 首页故事和近期新建的高星 GitHub 仓库，为技术晨报提供原始素材。它向根 Agent 注册 brief_fetch 工具，调用后并行查询两个公开 API，并将标题、链接、分数等结果交给 Agent 自行整理。用户可调整条目上限和筛选阈值，也可提供可选 GitHub token。

dsh-brief (a DSH plugin) fetches Hacker News front-page stories and new, highly starred GitHub repositories on demand. The brief_fetch tool queries both public APIs and returns raw entries for an agent-written tech digest. Limits and thresholds are configurable; a GitHub token is optional.
想让 DSH 按需收集 Hacker News 和新兴 GitHub 项目，整理成今天的技术简报。
Can my agent fetch current Hacker News stories and recently popular GitHub repos when I ask for a tech digest?
dsh-brief 的「按需抓取简报素材」功能：Agent 调用 brief_fetch 后并行获取 Hacker News 首页故事和近期新建的高星 GitHub 仓库，返回标题、链接、分数等原始条目，由 Agent 编写摘要。
dsh-brief 使用前须知：调用时会向 Hacker News 与 GitHub API 请求公开条目；GitHub token 可选。（见 lib/sources.js:7-8,21-26,50-54）
dsh-brief 使用前须知：配置 githubToken 后，插件会将其作为 Bearer 凭据发送给 api.github.com；不配置时请求不带该凭据。（见 lib/sources.js:50-54）
dsh-brief 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 38 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-brief README · dsh-brief：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives
your agent **one tool**: `brief_fetch`. It gathers today's raw tech-briefing entries —
Hacker News front page + recently-created high-star GitHub repos — and the agent writes
your morning digest from them.

dsh-brief README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:xiaoshuai1024/dsh-brief#main"
```

(profile name is yours: `web`, `headless`, …)

dsh-brief README · Use：Just ask, in any session:

> 来一份今天的技术晨报 / give me today's tech brief

The agent calls `brief_fetch`, gets the raw entries, and writes the digest. Ask it to
save the result to a file, compare with last week, or filter by keyword — normal agent
work, no plugin change needed.

dsh-brief README · Extend：Add a source = add one fetcher in `lib/sources.js` and one entry list in the tool
output (`lib/tools.js`). Good candidates: arXiv new papers, lobste.rs, an RSS feed you
own. Keep fetchers pure (fetch → JSON, no summarizing).
